description: This is a Java JUnit test class for testing the RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl class, which is part of a larger project related to 'eclipse.ditto'. It contains unit tests to verify immutability, equality, exception handling, and method behaviors of the class under test.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl, containing various test methods to verify its behavior and properties.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case, creating a RetrieveAttribute instance and the class under test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetRetrieveAttributeLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the factory method throws NullPointerException with expected message.

methods.name: tryToGetRetrieveAttributeLiveCommandForCreateAttributeCommand
methods.description: Tests that passing an incompatible command mock throws ClassCastException.

methods.name: getRetrieveAttributeLiveCommandReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the loaded command's properties match those of the input.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that setting DittoHeaders on the command returns a new command with the expected headers.

methods.name: answerReturnsNotNull
methods.description: Checks that the answer() method on the command returns a non-null result.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString() method includes expected content.
